# Logistic Lasso

```{r, warning = FALSE}
n = nrow(data)
K = 10 # 10-fold CV
Prediction_index = 4

# 설정하려는 Seed 총 개수
Seed_Num = 10
  
# Seed, parameter 별로 일단 모두 저장
Accuracy_LRL <- vector(mode = "list", length = Seed_Num)
FPR_LRL <- vector(mode = "list", length = Seed_Num)
FNR_LRL <- vector(mode = "list", length = Seed_Num)
F1_LRL <- vector(mode = "list", length = Seed_Num)

# Parameter grid 설정
threshold_grid <- seq(from = 0, to = 1, length.out = 51)
lambda_grid <- 10^seq(2, -5, length = 70) # 10의 exponent로 grid 생성

for(seed in 1:Seed_Num){  # Seed를 다르게 하는 For loop
  print("seed")
  print(seed)
  set.seed(seed)
  
  # Parameter 별로 For loop
  for(threshold in threshold_grid){

      for(CV in 1:K){
        ########################################################################################
        # CV generation. Train : Test를 9:1로 나눔 (이때의 train, test는 validation approach)  #
        ########################################################################################
        CV_index <- split(sample(1:n), rep(1:K, length.out = n))
        train <- data[-CV_index[[CV]], ] # Train set
        train_index <- c(1:n) 
        train_index <- train_index[-CV_index[[CV]]] # Train set의 index (필요할 경우 사용)
        test <- data[CV_index[[CV]], ] # Test set
        test_rowNum <- nrow(test) # Test set row Numbers (필요할 경우 사용))
        
        #################################################################
        # Modeling and Prediction. Update Accuracy, FNR, FPR, F1 score  #
        #################################################################
        Model <- glmnet(as.matrix(train[, -Prediction_index]), train$target, family = "binomial", alpha = 1, lambda = lambda_grid)
        
        
        for(lambda_ind in 1:length(lambda_grid)){
          prob_pred <- predict(Model, s = lambda_grid[lambda_ind], newx = as.matrix(test[, -Prediction_index]), type = "response")
          pred <- rep(0, test_rowNum)
          pred[prob_pred > threshold] <- 1
        
          # Update Scores
          Accuracy_LRL[[seed]] <- c(Accuracy_LRL[[seed]], mean(pred == test$target))
          FPR_LRL[[seed]] <- c(FPR_LRL[[seed]], mean((pred != test$target) & (test$target == 0)) / mean(test$target == 0))
          FNR_LRL[[seed]] <- c(FNR_LRL[[seed]], mean((pred != test$target) & (test$target == 1)) / mean(test$target == 1))
          F1_LRL[[seed]] <- c(F1_LRL[[seed]], 2*(mean((pred==test$target)&(test$target==1))/(mean(pred==1))*mean((pred==test$target)&(test$target==1))/(mean(test$target==1))) / (mean((pred==test$target)&(test$target==1))/(mean(pred==1))+mean((pred==test$target)&(test$target==1))/(mean(test$target==1))))  
        }
      }
    
  }
}
```

## CV meaning process

```{r}
# Seed, parameter 별로 CV에 대해 평균내어 모두 저장
CVAccuracy_LRL <- vector(mode = "list", length = Seed_Num)
CVFPR_LRL <- vector(mode = "list", length = Seed_Num)
CVFNR_LRL <- vector(mode = "list", length = Seed_Num)
CVF1_LRL <- vector(mode = "list", length = Seed_Num)

for(seed in 1:Seed_Num){  # Seed를 다르게 하는 For loop
  # Parameter 별로 For loop
  for(param1 in 1:length(threshold_grid)){
    for(param2 in 1:length(lambda_grid)){
      CVAccuracy_LRL[[seed]] <- c(CVAccuracy_LRL[[seed]], mean(Accuracy_LRL[[seed]][param2 + (0:(K-1)) * length(lambda_grid) + (param1-1) * K * length(lambda_grid)]))
      CVFPR_LRL[[seed]] <- c(CVFPR_LRL[[seed]], mean(FPR_LRL[[seed]][param2 + (0:(K-1)) * length(lambda_grid) + (param1-1) * K * length(lambda_grid)]))
      CVFNR_LRL[[seed]] <- c(CVFNR_LRL[[seed]], mean(FNR_LRL[[seed]][param2 + (0:(K-1)) * length(lambda_grid) + (param1-1) * K * length(lambda_grid)]))
      CVF1_LRL[[seed]] <- c(CVF1_LRL[[seed]], mean(F1_LRL[[seed]][param2 + (0:(K-1)) * length(lambda_grid) + (param1-1) * K * length(lambda_grid)]))
    }
  }
}
```

## Accuracy

```{r}
LRL_Accuracy <- as.data.frame(CVAccuracy_LRL)
colnames(LRL_Accuracy) <- c("CV1", "CV2", "CV3", "CV4", "CV5", "CV6", "CV7", "CV8", "CV9", "CV10")
LRL_Accuracy <- as.data.frame(t(as.matrix(LRL_Accuracy)))

LRL_Accuracy
```

```{r}
LRL_Accuracy <- LRL_Accuracy %>%
  gather(key = "Parameter", value = "Accuracy")%>%
  mutate(lambda = lambda_grid[((row_number()-1)%/%K)%%(length(lambda_grid))+1])%>%
  mutate(threshold = threshold_grid[(((row_number()-1)%/%K)%/%(length(lambda_grid)))+1])%>%
  mutate(CV = (row_number()-1)%%K + 1)
                              

LRL_Accuracy_lambdaCV <- LRL_Accuracy %>%
  group_by(lambda, CV)%>%
  summarise(Accuracy = max(Accuracy))%>%
  mutate(lambda = log(lambda, base = 10))

LRL_Accuracy_lambda <- LRL_Accuracy_lambdaCV%>%
  group_by(lambda)%>%
  summarise(Accuracy = mean(Accuracy))
```

```{r}
ggplot() +
  geom_boxplot(data = LRL_Accuracy_lambdaCV, mapping = aes(x = lambda, y = Accuracy, group = lambda), alpha = 0.5, size = 0.5) +
  geom_line(data = LRL_Accuracy_lambda, mapping = aes(x = lambda, y = Accuracy), color = "blue")+
  theme_bw()+
  xlab("Log lambda")+
  ggtitle("Lasso", subtitle = "Accuracy")
```

```{r}
ggplot() +
  geom_boxplot(data = LRL_Accuracy_lambdaCV %>% filter(lambda < -1), mapping = aes(x = lambda, y = Accuracy, group = lambda), alpha = 0.5, size = 0.2) +
  geom_line(data = LRL_Accuracy_lambda %>% filter(lambda < -1), mapping = aes(x = lambda, y = Accuracy), color = "blue")+
  theme_bw()+
  xlab("Log lambda")+
  ggtitle("Lasso", subtitle = "Accuracy")
```

```{r}
LRL_Accuracy_lambda[which.max(LRL_Accuracy_lambda$Accuracy),]
```

## F1 score

```{r}
LRL_F1 <- as.data.frame(CVF1_LRL)
colnames(LRL_F1) <- c("CV1", "CV2", "CV3", "CV4", "CV5", "CV6", "CV7", "CV8", "CV9", "CV10")
LRL_F1 <- as.data.frame(t(as.matrix(LRL_F1)))

LRL_F1
```

```{r}
LRL_F1 <- LRL_F1 %>%
  gather(key = "Parameter", value = "F1")%>%
  mutate(lambda = lambda_grid[((row_number()-1)%/%K)%%(length(lambda_grid))+1])%>%
  mutate(threshold = threshold_grid[(((row_number()-1)%/%K)%/%(length(lambda_grid)))+1])%>%
  mutate(CV = (row_number()-1)%%K + 1)
                              

LRL_F1_lambdaCV <- LRL_F1 %>%
  group_by(lambda, CV)%>%
  summarise(F1 = max(F1, na.rm = TRUE))%>%
  mutate(lambda = log(lambda, base = 10))


LRL_F1_lambda <- LRL_F1_lambdaCV%>%
  group_by(lambda)%>%
  summarise(F1 = mean(F1))
```

```{r}
ggplot() +
  geom_boxplot(data = LRL_F1_lambdaCV, mapping = aes(x = lambda, y = F1, group = lambda), alpha = 0.5, size = 0.2) +
  geom_line(data = LRL_F1_lambda, mapping = aes(x = lambda, y = F1), color = "blue")+
  theme_bw()+
  xlab("Log lambda")
  ggtitle("Ridge", subtitle = "F1 score")
```
```{r}
ggplot() +
  geom_boxplot(data = LRL_F1_lambdaCV %>% filter(lambda < -3), mapping = aes(x = lambda, y = F1, group = lambda), alpha = 0.5, size = 0.2) +
  geom_line(data = LRL_F1_lambda %>% filter(lambda < -3), mapping = aes(x = lambda, y = F1), color = "blue")+
  theme_bw()+
  xlab("Log lambda")+
  ggtitle("Lasso", subtitle = "F1 score")
```

# Conclusion

- F1 score

Regularized 된 term이 없을 때 최대 : 즉, 일반적인 LR을 택하면 됨.

- Accuracy

lambda = -1.956에서 best performance

Seed 1 : 0.70896

Seed 1~10 : average 0.70885, standard deviation 0.0055050, median 0.70862
